## Download

| Your computer | Download | Then |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows 10 or 11** | [SpaceHunter.exe](https://github.com/knox-101/space-hunter/releases/download/vVERSION/SpaceHunter.exe) | Double-click it; there's nothing to install. If Windows SmartScreen warns, click **More info → Run anyway**. It asks for administrator rights so it can clean Windows' own folders. |
| **Mac** (macOS 13 or later, Apple silicon or Intel) | [SpaceHunter-mac.zip](https://github.com/knox-101/space-hunter/releases/download/vVERSION/SpaceHunter-mac.zip) | Unzip it and move **Space Hunter** to Applications. The first time, open it once (macOS will refuse), then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. On macOS 13–14, right-click the app → **Open** also works. |

Already have Space Hunter? It offers this version by itself the next time you open it. The `.sig` files are for
that built-in updater; you don't need them.
